notes.title: Fallen girl - Black rose and the fire of desire -----Version update
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your support. The content of this update is as follows:

1. Fixed some bugs that the pictures could not be displayed normally.

2. Fixed some sound bugs.


We are retranslating the English text to enhance the English game experience, which is expected to be launched in August.
